title: Find the full names and phone numbers of members who incurred approved expe
question: Find the full names and phone numbers of members who incurred approved expenses exceeding the average cost of all approved expenses for 'Advertisement' category events held in September.

prediction.sql:
WITH avg_advertisement_sept AS (
  SELECT AVG(e."XCL_020") AS avg_cost
  FROM expense AS e
  INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e."XCL_023" = b."XCL_003"
  INNER JOIN event AS ev ON b."XCL_009" = ev."XCL_010"
  WHERE e."XCL_021" = 'true'
    AND b."XCL_004" = 'Advertisement'
    AND SUBSTRING(ev."XCL_012", 6, 2) = '09'
)
SELECT DISTINCT m."XCL_035" || ' ' || m."XCL_036" AS full_name, m."XCL_040" AS phone
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN expense AS e ON m."XCL_034" = e."XCL_022"
INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e."XCL_023" = b."XCL_003"
INNER JOIN event AS ev ON b."XCL_009" = ev."XCL_010"
WHERE e."XCL_021" = 'true'
  AND b."XCL_004" = 'Advertisement'
  AND SUBSTRING(ev."XCL_012", 6, 2) = '09'
  AND e."XCL_020" > (SELECT avg_cost FROM avg_advertisement_sept)
